long_biography.plain_text:
An engineer by education, Sparaggis completed graduate work in electrical and computer systems and earned an MBA at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. He entered securities analysis at Credit Suisse First Boston and moved to Oppenheimer, where he became a senior portfolio manager responsible for mid-cap accounts. In 2002, he launched his own firm with an established team and strategy from CIBC.

Today he controls the adviser and remains its senior investment decision-maker. Alkeon deploys bottom-up fundamental research across listed growth equities and private innovation companies. The portfolios comprise capital entrusted by clients and fund investors: assets under management, reported positions and investment performance therefore belong to those vehicles, not automatically to Sparaggis. His personal wealth mechanism is ownership of the fee-earning management business and related adviser interests, rather than every security selected for its funds.

The New York-based Greek hedgefund manager Takis Sparaggis, who already owned the 55m Benetti Ocean Paradise, has acquired further yachts.

The 47m Benetti Imagination series Africa I is owned by a Maltese company which is controlled by a Luxembourg company called DPS Holdings SCSp. 

A further search reveals that Mr Sparaggis is the ultimate beneficial owner behind this Luxembourg company. It turns out that DPS Holdings is also the registered owner of one further yacht: the Akhir 100 Shooting Star, completed in 2004.

As with the purchase of Ocean Paradise, Mr Sparaggis was represented during the acquisition of Africa I by Peter Riginos of Riginos Yachts. For the purchase of Shooting Star, Mr Sparaggis enlisted the services of George Hapipis and Efthimis Karalis of A1 Yachting.

The source record identifies Greek nationality, and Sparaggis studied at the National Technical University of Athens. SEC filings identify him as a United States citizen, so American is proposed as a secondary nationality rather than replacing the Greek primary nationality.

Sparaggis is not classified from a chief-investment-officer title alone. SEC documents separately call him Alkeon's controlling person and document ownership of the adviser, supporting a personal founder-owner relationship.

Alkeon assets under management, portfolio values and securities positions generally belong to managed funds and their investors. Sparaggis created Alkeon after an employed investment career, but contemporary coverage describes a friendly team spinout and an investment strategy with an institutional track record predating the independent firm. Self-made — advantaged start captures that material business platform without implying inherited wealth.
No exact personal LinkedIn, Instagram, personal website or dedicated Forbes person profile was verified. Alkeon's canonical site is proposed only as a company website.
